name: eq3-06 / e04lc07-v4
summary: This EA implements a D'Alembert betting system for forex trading, managing a portfolio of currency pairs by tracking per-currency net exposure in EUR-terms. It opens positions based on exposure limits, scales in when price moves against the position (increasing lots after losses), and partially closes profitable positions. A Hamiltonian (closed-loop) currency pair set ensures net zero exposure across all value currencies.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了D'Alembert下注系统，通过追踪各货币净敞口（以欧元计价）来管理货币对组合。根据敞口限制开仓，价格逆向移动时加仓（亏损后增加手数），部分平仓获利头寸。使用哈密顿闭合货币对组合确保所有货币净敞口为零。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于D'Alembert下注系统——赢后减注、输后加注，通过追踪每种货币的净敞口来决定交易方向。入场条件：当某货币对无持仓且对应货币敞口未超限时，按预设方向（A数组）开仓；当价格朝不利方向移动超过TP阈值时，以最小手数加仓。出场条件：当价格朝有利方向移动超过阈值时部分平仓（减仓至最小手数后依靠TP平仓），或通过CleanBad函数在可接受亏损时强制减仓。仓位管理采用逐步加仓/减仓方式，每次增减LotMin手数，最大持仓受Limit_Position_Lot和Limit_Exposure_Lot双重限制。资金管理通过FreeBalance和BestBallance控制亏损平仓节奏，并设MinMargin保证金水平门槛和123.4%紧急保证金检查。ManageTP功能会在意外盈利时移动止盈点以锁定利润。整体策略核心是利用多货币对的自然对冲特性，通过哈密顿组合（如EURUSD-EURGBP-GBPUSD三角套利关系）维持低净敞口，再以D'Alembert方式在价格波动中逐步建仓和减仓。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a D'Alembert betting system — decreasing stakes after wins and increasing after losses — by tracking net exposure per currency in EUR terms. Entry conditions: when no position exists for a symbol and the corresponding currency exposures are within limits, it opens a position in the direction specified by array A; when price moves adversely beyond a TP threshold, it adds to the position in LotMin increments. Exit conditions: when price moves favorably beyond a threshold, it partially closes the position (reducing to LotMin then relying on TP for final exit), or the CleanBad function forces a reduction at an acceptable loss. Position sizing uses a stepwise add/reduce approach, adding or closing LotMin lots each time, with maximum position capped by Limit_Position_Lot and maximum per-currency exposure capped by Limit_Exposure_Lot. Money management controls loss-closing pace via FreeBalance and BestBallance, with a MinMargin threshold and an emergency 123.4% margin level check. The ManageTP feature moves take-profit levels when unexpected profit occurs to lock in gains. The core strategy exploits the natural hedging property of multi-currency portfolios through a Hamiltonian set (e.g., EURUSD-EURGBP-GBPUSD triangular relationship) to maintain low net exposure, then uses the D'Alembert approach to gradually build and reduce positions during price fluctuations.

pros: 利用哈密顿货币对组合实现天然对冲，降低整体净敞口风险
D'Alembert仓位管理在趋势回归时有较好的均价改善效果
双重敞口限制（单币种+单货币对）有效控制风险敞口过度集中
ManageTP功能能在意外盈利时锁定收益，避免利润回吐
保证金水平和紧急检查（123.4%）提供了资金安全底线
pros_en: Uses Hamiltonian currency pair sets for natural hedging, reducing overall net exposure risk
D'Alembert position sizing improves average entry price effectively during mean-reverting markets
Dual exposure limits (per-currency and per-symbol) effectively prevent risk concentration
ManageTP feature locks in gains during unexpected profits, avoiding profit giveback
Margin level checks and emergency threshold (123.4%) provide capital safety floor
cons: D'Alembert系统在单边趋势中会持续加仓，导致亏损不断放大
无止损（SL=0），完全依赖逐步减仓机制，极端行情下可能爆仓
全局变量I/J贯穿所有函数，存在严重的状态耦合和重入风险
Exposure()函数中非EUR货币转换假设EUR+XXX始终存在，缺少容错处理
代码结构混乱，大量全局变量和隐式依赖，可读性和可维护性差
cons_en: D'Alembert system continuously adds positions during trending markets, amplifying losses indefinitely
No stop-loss (SL=0), relying entirely on gradual reduction mechanism — margin call possible in extreme moves
Global variables I/J used across all functions create severe state coupling and reentrancy risks
Exposure() function assumes EUR+XXX symbols always exist for currency conversion, no error handling for missing symbols
Messy code structure with extensive global variables and implicit dependencies, poor readability and maintainability
improvements: 添加硬止损（SL）作为极端行情的最后一道防线，避免爆仓风险
将全局变量I/J改为函数参数传递，消除状态耦合和重入隐患
在Exposure()中添加SymbolInfoDouble返回值检查，防止EUR+XXX货币对不存在时除零错误
improvements_en: Add hard stop-loss (SL) as a last line of defense against extreme market moves to prevent margin calls
Refactor global variables I/J into function parameters to eliminate state coupling and reentrancy hazards
Add return value checks in Exposure() for SymbolInfoDouble calls to prevent division-by-zero when EUR+XXX symbols are missing

risk_points: 无硬止损（SL=0），极端行情下可能持续加仓至爆仓
D'Alembert加仓策略在单边趋势中会导致亏损指数级增长
全局变量状态耦合导致函数重入时可能产生错误交易指令
Exposure()中货币转换未做容错，SymbolInfoDouble返回0时将导致除零错误
risk_points_en: No hard stop-loss (SL=0) — sustained adverse moves can lead to continuous position additions and margin call
D'Alembert position sizing causes exponentially growing losses during sustained trending markets
Global variable state coupling can produce incorrect trade orders during function reentrancy
Exposure() currency conversion lacks error handling — SymbolInfoDouble returning 0 causes division-by-zero
